resources.title: DO THIS FIRST in POE2 0.5 Endgame
resources.creator: Spud the King
resources.noteEs: Primer paso en el endgame de 0.5: Spud the King prioriza qué hacer al entrar al Atlas redesignado — qué Master desbloquear primero, qué Fortress segments perseguir, qué Atlas Tree points apuntar. Reemplaza la lógica del 0.4 endgame loop con la nueva estructura de Return of the Ancients.
resources.noteEn: First steps into 0.5's endgame: Spud the King prioritizes what to do when entering the redesigned Atlas — which Master to unlock first, which Fortress segments to chase, which Atlas Tree points to target. Replaces the 0.4 endgame loop logic with the Return of the Ancients structure.

resources.title: Path of Exile 2 Arbiter of Divinity Boss Guide All Lore, Mechanics Shown Full Questline New Pinnacle
resources.creator: Fredchuckdave
resources.noteEs: Guía completa del nuevo pinnacle boss de 0.5: Arbiter of Divinity, el reemplazo del Arbiter of Ash como cara final del Atlas. Fredchuckdave cubre lore, mecánicas, questline y el kill — 20 minutos publicados el día del lanzamiento. Obligatorio para players que vayan por el pinnacle del cycle nuevo.
resources.noteEn: Complete guide to 0.5's new pinnacle boss: Arbiter of Divinity, the replacement for Arbiter of Ash as the Atlas's final face. Fredchuckdave covers lore, mechanics, questline, and the kill — 20 minutes published on launch day. Required for players going after the new cycle's pinnacle.

resources.title: COMO MATAR AL ARBITER OF THE ASH
resources.creator: BuBahz
resources.noteEs: Anchor en español para Arbiter of the Ash. Aunque dejó de ser el pinnacle principal en 0.5 (lo reemplazó Arbiter of Divinity), sigue siendo accesible desde la Fortress con fragments y mantiene su loot table — las mecánicas que BuBahz explica siguen vigentes para players que vayan por su unique drops.
resources.noteEn: Spanish anchor for Arbiter of the Ash. Although it stopped being the main pinnacle in 0.5 (replaced by Arbiter of Divinity), it's still accessible from the Fortress with fragments and keeps its loot table — the mechanics BuBahz explains still apply for players going after its unique drops.

resources.title: Path of Exile 2 - How to Beat Trial of Chaos and the Trialmaster
resources.creator: Tenkiei
resources.noteEs: Tenkiei cubre el Trial of Chaos completo y la pelea final contra el Trialmaster: estrategia para evadir mecánicas (hugging walls), gear recommendations, y cómo gestionar el escalado de afflictions a través de los pisos. El Trialmaster sigue siendo una de las pinnacle routes centrales de PoE 2 en 0.5 — guía obligatoria si vas por esa ascendency.
resources.noteEn: Tenkiei covers the full Trial of Chaos and the final Trialmaster fight: strategy to dodge mechanics (hugging walls), gear recommendations, and how to manage affliction scaling across floors. The Trialmaster remains one of PoE 2's central pinnacle routes in 0.5 — required guide if you're going that ascendancy.

resources.title: Quick Boss Guide for all the Citadel Bosses! Plus my Strat!
resources.creator: Darkgage
resources.noteEs: Quick guide para los 3 Citadel bosses (Copper - Jamanra, Iron - Geonor, Stone - Doryani). Darkgage condensa las mecánicas de cada uno + su strat de farming en 11 minutos. Útil como referencia rápida durante un run cuando llegas a un Citadel y necesitas repaso ágil sin perder tiempo. Las mecánicas core de cada boss siguen iguales en 0.5.
resources.noteEn: Quick guide for the 3 Citadel bosses (Copper - Jamanra, Iron - Geonor, Stone - Doryani). Darkgage condenses each one's mechanics + his farming strat into 11 minutes. Useful as a fast reference during a run when you reach a Citadel and need a quick refresher without wasting time. The core mechanics of each boss are the same in 0.5.
